notes.birnkrant-college: OSM doesn't name it; pinned at the centre USC Housing's interactive map (housing.usc.edu/index.php/interactive-map/) gives Birnkrant Residential College (BSR).

detours.why: North Residential College's mapped entrance is on its south side (Downey Way) and no mapped path crosses between the hall and the buildings just north of it, so walks to them go round the hall's block by McClintock Avenue.
